claim: fcsc --demo runs a bundled sample in a new temporary sandbox.
sandbox: fresh working directory; assert realistic actions, printed temp path, manifest, and no working-directory changes

claim: Planning changes no source or destination files.
sandbox: temporary conflicting trees; hash and compare both trees before and after an overwrite plan

claim: The default scan reads metadata without requiring regular file contents.
sandbox: plan an unreadable regular file as an unprivileged user and assert its metadata action

claim: Overwrite, skip, and keep-both produce policy-specific plans.
sandbox: temporary conflict with an occupied copy suffix; assert overwrite, skip, and next keep-both name

claim: Sparse files receive conservative lower and upper allocation bounds.
sandbox: 64 MiB sparse file; assert lower allocation is below the expanded upper bound

claim: Unchanged inputs produce byte-identical, sorted JSON plans.
sandbox: same unsorted fixture planned twice; compare stdout bytes and action order

claim: The safer sparse upper bound controls the space verdict.
sandbox: planner boundary fixture where free space is between lower and upper requirements

claim: fcsc prints JSON and can save the same schema-1 manifest.
sandbox: temporary source; compare parsed stdout with the saved manifest

claim: Exit codes are 0 safe, 1 invalid, 2 insufficient, and 3 unchecked.
sandbox: temporary normal, invalid, oversized sparse, and no-space-check runs

claim: cargo install --path . --locked installs fcsc from a source checkout.
sandbox: fresh Cargo consumer root; install and execute fcsc --version

claim: The CLI works without accounts, telemetry, or network access.
sandbox: run the real binary with an injected socket guard and assert no socket call

claim: The browser demo uses fixed sample data, accepts no local files, resets, and saves nothing.
sandbox: fresh phone browser context; change policy, inspect output, reset, and inspect browser storage

claim: The site uses no analytics, cookies, remote fonts, or third-party runtime code.
sandbox: record all requests and cookies during the complete home-to-demo flow

claim: The documentation and sample demo reload offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated browser context; wait for service worker, go offline, and reload /demo

claim: The manifest is data and never executes file transfers.
sandbox: save a manifest, assert it is non-executable, and compare the destination tree

claim: Dense fixture estimates stay within 2% of actual allocated-byte changes.
sandbox: copy dense conflict fixtures under all three policies and measure allocation deltas

claim: The Linux download is the tested fcsc 0.1.0 release binary.
sandbox: compare staged download bytes with the release binary and execute --version
